claims: Celle is a historic town in Lower Saxony, Germany.
Celle has medieval timber-framed houses particularly in the Altstadt.
Celle has ducal Celle Castle.
Celle is situated on the River Aller.
Celle features a 17th-century theater.
Celle features a 24-hour art museum.
Celle was a former ducal residence.
Celle has one of the highest concentrations of half-timbered houses in Germany.
Celle has over 400 restored timber-framed homes.
Hoppener Haus is a timber-framed house in Celle.
Celle Castle is Schloss Celle.
Celle Castle blends Renaissance and Baroque architecture.
Celle Castle features one of the oldest theaters in Germany.
Celle Castle features a chapel.
Bomann Museum is a local history museum in Celle.
Kunstmuseum Celle is a modern art museum in Celle.
Celle is located near Hannover in Lower Saxony.
Celle is a French feminine demonstrative pronoun meaning "the one".
In French, "celle de Pierre" means "the one belonging to Pierre".
Zelle® is a digital payment network in the US.
